dict.string: Find and open Apple Mail mailboxes across accounts.
Search mailboxes by name, account, or path

# Apple Mail Navigator
Type `mail` in Alfred, then a mailbox name, account, or path. Examples: `mail sen`, `mail work arch`, `mail active proj`, `mail saborio inbox`.
- Return: activate Mail and select the mailbox; clear message selection. - Command-Return: copy the account and mailbox path without navigating. - `mail :refresh`: refresh discovery in the background. - `mail :clear`: clear recent/frequent navigation history. - Optional hotkey: assign the unbound Hotkey object in Alfred Preferences → Workflows → Apple Mail Navigator. No existing shortcut is replaced.
## Navigation
Uses the installed Mail scripting dictionary's writable `selected mailboxes` property on a message viewer. Resolves accounts by account ID, and mailboxes by full account-relative path, rather than display name or row number. Checks the selected mailbox reference after assignment; Mail may update asynchronously. Creates a message viewer when none exists. Launches/activates Mail as needed. No message content is queried; no send, delete, move, read-status, or account settings commands are issued. Mail itself can restore a previously selected message while changing mailboxes; selection is cleared before and after navigation. No Accessibility, screen recording, mouse coordinates, or undocumented URLs are required. Message-list keyboard focus is left to Mail because its scripting API does not provide a reliable focus control.
## Discovery and matching
Includes account and local mailboxes, nested paths, and unified Inbox, Sent, Drafts, Junk, and Trash. Smart mailboxes, Flagged, unified Archive, and Option-Return sidebar reveal are deliberately omitted: a reliable supported implementation has not been verified. Individual Archive mailboxes are included.
Exact names rank first, then prefixes, word matches, then subsequence fuzzy matches. Within each tier, recent visits and frequency rank next. Case and combining diacritics are ignored. Shorter matching names break ties, so `sen` prefers Sent over SendLater. Empty search shows recent choices first, with unified mailboxes as the initial defaults. IDs derive from account ID and full path; renaming a mailbox changes its ID and resets its individual history.
## Cache and permissions
Only Python 3 standard library and macOS osascript are used. Verified interpreter: `/usr/bin/python3` (3.9.6). No downloads. Alfred supplies workflow cache and data paths; standalone commands fall back to `~/Library/Caches/org.csaborio.alfred.mail-navigator` and `~/Library/Application Support/Alfred/Workflow Data/org.csaborio.alfred.mail-navigator`. Runtime data is never written into this iCloud workflow folder. JSON writes use atomic replacement; refresh uses an exclusive lock. Metadata refreshes after 15 minutes when invoked, or on explicit refresh. Ordinary filtering only reads cache; background discovery is bounded to 60 seconds and may take tens of seconds. Cached listings remain available during refresh. Cold startup displays discovery status and reruns until results arrive. Failed refreshes retain the old cache and show an actionable error. Offline accounts use Mail's locally exposed metadata; account network behavior is controlled by Mail.
Allow Alfred to control Mail if macOS asks. For a denied prompt, open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Automation → Alfred → Mail, then `mail :refresh`. Alfred already has permission to handle its clipboard output. The optional hotkey and error redisplay use Alfred's own scripting API. Accessibility and screen recording are not workflow requirements.
## Troubleshooting
- Missing/renamed folder: open Mail, wait for accounts to load, then `mail :refresh`. - Automation timeout: retry after Mail finishes launching or syncing. - A failed navigation reopens Alfred with the error; use the refresh result. - No results: check spelling or use an account name; `mail :` shows maintenance. - After a macOS update, refresh and re-test navigation. This version was tested against macOS 27.2 build 26B123 and Alfred 5.8.1 on Apple silicon. - To reset everything, remove only this workflow's cache/data directories. - Run tests: `/usr/bin/python3 -B tests/test_navigator.py` from this folder.
## Validation performed on 6 November 2026
- Inspected existing workflows, active iCloud preferences, keyword configuration, installed software, and the on-disk Mail scripting dictionary. - Discovered 141 entries: 129 account mailboxes over four accounts, seven local mailboxes, five unified mailboxes. All 141 references resolved without errors. - Live navigation verified for ScorpioTek Sent, Fastmail Sent, Gmail Sent Mail, nested ScorpioTek/Active Projects, and unified Inbox/Sent/Drafts/Junk/Trash. - Alfred discovered the workflow and displayed `mail sen` results. - Cached subprocess searches measured about 40–55 ms on this machine. - Tested fuzzy/multiword/diacritic matching, duplicate identity, recent ordering, corrupted cache recovery, simulated automation failure, history clearing, JSON, and graph wiring. Actual privacy denial was simulated, not imposed on the user. - Did not quit the user's running Mail to test cold launch, disconnect accounts, rename/delete real mailboxes, or alter messages. Cold launch, offline operation, and future macOS versions remain limitations of the live validation. - Only the new workflow was installed; existing workflow files were not edited.
